question: Given a declared finite set of constants and a declared family of expressions over it, what share of the seven hundred twenty-nine praises does the family name, and how many expressions name each praise? Does a claim that a family names a target uniquely carry any information once the share is known? And, separately, given a declared shift on the eighty-one heads, how many of its pairs lie inside a declared cut and how many straddle it, and is that split a fact about the cut or an identity of the shift?
level: External exact combinatorics on a declared expression family over the integers one to seven hundred twenty-nine, and on a declared shift of the eighty-one heads; no text and no corpus count imported
domain: Seven hundred twenty-nine praises as the target set, ten declared constant sets from one to seventy-three members, one declared family of five expressions with a declared multiplier range, the eight hundred forty-one heads as a ternary address space, and one declared shift with all eighty cuts
quantifiers: All ten declared constant sets for the coverage, the price and the multiplicity
All twenty-nine nested pairs of declared constant sets for monotonicity
All ninety prefixes of the integers for the interval statement
All ninety candidates of the declared pool at every step of the greedy
All seven hundred twenty-nine praises for the multiplicity histogram
All six thousand four hundred pairs of a shift and a cut for the closed form
All eighty shifts for the count of pairs with a constant coordinate difference
All forty-one pairs of the declared shift for the difference pattern
grammar: exact integer arithmetic for the image and the multiplicities
exact rational arithmetic over Fraction for the coverage
declared enumeration of the expression family, with the bare form carrying no partner
direct counting compared against a closed form for the shift and the cut
acceptance: A family of five forms over a declared constant set names a computable subset of the seven hundred twenty-nine praises, and the thirteen constants of the earlier note name four hundred ninety-seven of them, which is a coverage of 497/729 and is the price of a hit

Adding a constant never removes a value from the image and never removes an expression naming a praise, so both the coverage and every praise's multiplicity are monotone in the constant set and can only be destroyed by adding constants, never created

The first n consecutive integers name exactly the praises one to ten n while ten n is at most seven hundred twenty-nine, so the first seventy-two name seven hundred twenty and the first seventy-three name every praise, which is a coverage of one

A declared greedy over a declared pool of ninety candidates reaches every praise with fourteen constants, while counting the expressions a constant set can write forces at least seven, so the smallest covering set lies between those figures and this experiment does not decide it

A target that is itself a declared constant is named by the bare form, so a family that contains its target has proved nothing; removing the target from the constants leaves five expressions naming it and lowers the coverage to 472/729
The largest multiplicity over the thirteen constants is fifteen, attained at the praise fifty-four, and no praise is named more often than the family has expressions
Every praise not named by the family is named by none, and the second of the two earlier numbers is one of them, which the trivial constant repairs by exactly one expression
For every shift and every cut the pairs split into those inside the cut and those straddling it, and the closed form agrees with the direct count at all six thousand four hundred pairs
The declared shift makes forty-one pairs of which seven lie inside the declared cut and thirty-four straddle it, and the size of the cut's second side is also thirty-four

The crossing count equals the size of the cut's second side at forty of the eighty cuts for the declared shift, beginning at forty-one, so the agreement at forty-seven is an identity of the shift rather than a fact about the cut

The declared shift is the numeral one one one one in base three, and the coordinate difference of a pair is exactly one in every place for sixteen of the forty-one pairs, which are the pairs that add without carrying

Holding the thirteen constants fixed and varying only the multiplier range moves the coverage from two hundred twenty-three praises at two to four hundred ninety-seven at eight and nine, five hundred sixty-nine at twelve and six hundred sixty-four at twenty, and the multiplier ladder is monotone
The number of carry-free pairs is the product over the four places of three minus the digit of the shift, for every one of the eighty shifts
protected: No classical text, edition, transcription, commentary, name table, symbol table, sequence or annotation is imported, and no corpus count from any external repository is imported or recomputed here. No list of constants taken from a text is imported; every constant set in this experiment is declared in this contract

Figures reported elsewhere for a constant set this experiment does not have are cited as that record's and are neither reproduced nor re-derived here; the coverage computed here is for the declared sets only, and the two are different quantities

The multiplier range of the family is a declared parameter and not a natural bound: the coverage figures are for the declared range and would differ for another, so a family that does not declare its multiplier range has no computable price
The family is one declared family among many and is not claimed to be the family a text or a reader would use

The coverage is a ratio of two finite counts and not a probability: it equals the chance that a target drawn uniformly from the praises and independently of the constant set is named, and no target here was drawn that way
No claim that any number's presence in or absence from the image is meaningful, intended, or evidence about any text
The crossing identity is a statement about one declared shift on the head numbers and is not a claim about pairings, oppositions, seasons, calendars or any other structure

The three head numbers of the address spaces and the shift are declared as numbers; naming them after any text's vocabulary is a convenience of earlier notes and no reading of any text is performed here
No claim that the pair count recorded elsewhere is wrong about the text it was taken from: what is decided here is what the stated law implies arithmetically
No floating-point value enters any acceptance test
No native Rust witness, no claim promotion beyond bounded-external-experiment, no Seal, no library admission
residual: What is established is a set of exact statements about two declared finite structures. For a declared constant set and a declared family of five forms with a declared multiplier range, the share of the seven hundred twenty-nine praises the family names is computable exactly, it is monotone in the constant set, and it is the price of any claim that some expression names a target: the thirteen constants of the earlier note name four hundred ninety-seven praises, which is 497/729, and the first seventy-three integers name all of them, so a family rich enough reaches everything. A target that is itself in the constant set is named by the bare form and the claim is empty, which is why the set must exclude its target; removing this experiment's target lowers the coverage to 472/729 and leaves five expressions naming it. The smallest constant set that names every praise is not decided: a declared greedy reaches every praise with fourteen constants and counting the forms forces at least seven, and the true minimum lies in that interval. The multiplier range is a declared parameter, so these figures belong to the declared family and to no other, and a record that reports a coverage without declaring its family's multiplier range has not reported a computable price. For the declared shift of forty on the eighty-one heads the pairs number forty-one, seven lie inside the declared cut and thirty-four straddle it, and the cut's second side also has thirty-four members; but the crossing count equals the size of the second side at forty of the eighty cuts, beginning at forty-one, so the agreement is an identity of the shift and singles out no cut: the only distinguished cut in this structure is forty-one, where the second member of a pair can first exceed the cut, and forty-seven is not it. Because the shift is eleven eleven in base three, the coordinate difference of a pair is constant in every place for exactly sixteen of the forty-one pairs, the carry-free ones, and the count of those is the product of three minus the digits of the shift for every shift; the coordinate reading of the shift is therefore the wrong gauge, and the figures recorded elsewhere as thirteen of thirty-five cannot be reproduced from the stated law, which makes forty-one pairs and gives sixteen there. Nothing here decides any question about a text, and no corpus count and no constant list taken from a text is imported.
